# aidial_toolset (Resource)

Manages a toolset in DIAL Core (`PUT /v1/toolsets/{bucket}/{path}`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "aidial_toolset" "example" {
  bucket      = "platform"
  path        = "my-toolset"
  description = "Search and fetch tools served over MCP"
  endpoint    = "https://mcp.example.invalid/mcp"
  transport   = "HTTP"

  # Expose only some of the tools the server offers.
  allowed_tools = ["search", "fetch"]

  auth_settings = {
    authentication_type = "API_KEY"
    api_key_header      = "X-Api-Key"
  }
}

# Other buckets, such as "public", and nested paths work as well. For OAuth,
# provide the full block; the client secret stays out of the plan output.
resource "aidial_toolset" "oauth" {
  bucket   = "public"
  path     = "team/oauth-toolset"
  endpoint = "https://mcp.example.invalid/mcp"

  auth_settings = {
    authentication_type        = "OAUTH"
    authorization_endpoint     = "https://auth.example.invalid/authorize"
    token_endpoint             = "https://auth.example.invalid/token"
    token_endpoint_auth_method = "client_secret_post"
    client_id                  = "my-client"
    client_secret              = var.toolset_client_secret
    redirect_uri               = "https://dial.example.invalid/oauth/callback"
    code_challenge_method      = "S256"
    dynamically_registered     = false
    resource                   = "https://mcp.example.invalid"
    scopes_supported           = ["read"]
  }
}

variable "toolset_client_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket` (String) Target DIAL bucket, for example `platform` or `public`. DIAL Core decides which buckets it accepts for toolsets.
- `path` (String) Toolset path inside the target bucket.

### Optional

- `allowed_tools` (Set of String) Names of the tools the toolset exposes. An empty set, which DIAL Core defaults to, exposes all of them.
- `auth_settings` (Attributes) How DIAL Core authenticates to the toolset. Only configuration is exposed; session state such as sign-in status is not. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth_settings))
- `base_url` (String) Toolset-level base URL that completes `interfaces` entries without their own `base_url`.
- `catalog_properties` (Dynamic) Catalog metadata of the toolset (free-form object, sent as `catalogProperties`).
- `catalog_schema_id` (String) URI (`$id`) of the catalog schema describing `catalog_properties`, for example the `schema_id` of an `aidial_catalog_schema`.
- `default_headers` (Map of String) Additional headers sent with every request to the toolset's endpoint.
- `defaults` (Dynamic) Default request parameters (free-form object, sent to DIAL as-is).
- `dependencies` (Set of String) Deployments the toolset depends on.
- `description` (String) Toolset description.
- `description_keywords` (Set of String) Keywords describing the toolset.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable toolset name.
- `display_version` (String) Version shown for the toolset.
- `endpoint` (String) Toolset MCP endpoint, for example `http://toolset/v1/mcp`.
- `features` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--features))
- `forward_auth_token` (Boolean) Forward the caller's authorization token to the toolset. Defaults to false.
- `forward_per_request_key` (Boolean) Forward the per-request key to the toolset. Defaults to false.
- `icon_url` (String) URL of the toolset icon.
- `input_attachment_types` (Set of String) MIME types of accepted input attachments.
- `interceptors` (Set of String) Interceptors applied to requests.
- `interfaces` (Attributes Map) Per-interface deployment configuration, keyed by DIAL Core interface type: `openaiChatCompletions`, `openaiEmbeddings`, `openaiResponses`, `anthropicMessages`. The keys are Core's camelCase names and are sent as written; the attributes inside each entry use snake_case. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces))
- `intro` (String) Introductory text shown for the toolset.
- `max_input_attachments` (Number) Maximum number of attachments in one request.
- `max_retry_attempts` (Number) Maximum number of retry attempts. DIAL Core defaults to 1.
- `name` (String) Toolset name sent in the DIAL API request body. DIAL Core derives the name from the bucket and path, so it can be omitted; then it is read back from the API.
- `override_name` (String) Override of the toolset name presented to clients.
- `provider_name` (String) Name of the toolset provider (`provider` in the DIAL API; Terraform reserves that attribute name).
- `reference` (String) Reference identifier of the toolset. DIAL Core generates one when it is not set.
- `responses_defaults` (Dynamic) Default request parameters for Responses API requests (free-form object, sent as `responsesDefaults`).
- `responses_endpoint` (String) Endpoint used for Responses API requests.
- `transport` (String) MCP transport: `HTTP` or `SSE`. DIAL Core defaults to `HTTP`.
- `user_roles` (Set of String) Roles allowed to use the toolset.
- `vendor_website` (String) Website of the toolset vendor.

### Read-Only

- `api_name` (String) Canonical toolset name returned by the DIAL API.
- `author` (String) Author of the toolset, set by DIAL Core from the caller's identity.
- `id` (String) Resource identifier in the form <bucket>/<path>.

<a id="nestedatt--auth_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auth_settings`

Optional:

- `api_key_header` (String) Header that carries the API key (for `API_KEY`).
- `authentication_type` (String) One of `OAUTH`, `API_KEY`, `NONE`, `DIAL_NATIVE`. DIAL Core defaults to `NONE`.
- `authorization_endpoint` (String)
- `client_id` (String)
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) OAuth client secret. DIAL Core never returns it, so the configured value is kept in state; it is null after import.
- `code_challenge_method` (String)
- `dynamically_registered` (Boolean)
- `redirect_uri` (String)
- `resource` (String)
- `scopes_supported` (Set of String)
- `token_endpoint` (String)
- `token_endpoint_auth_method` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = aidial_toolset.example
  id = "platform/my-toolset"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by <bucket>/<path>. The path may contain "/" for nested folders.
# auth_settings.client_secret is never returned by DIAL Core, so it is null after import.
terraform import aidial_toolset.example platform/my-toolset
```
